event_chain.summary: Misdelivery - email addresses exposed via CC

summary: On August 11, 2026 the Metropolitan Police sent a monthly Operation Cornpoppy update email to 143 people who alleged sexual abuse by Mohamed Al Fayed without using blind copy, exposing all recipients' email addresses to each other. The Met blamed human error, apologised the same day, and referred itself to the ICO. It was the force's second data protection breach involving Fayed complainants in recent months.
